title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 38
text:
5. Choose the location-
identifying field
In the Field dropdown, select the 
criterion on which you want to 
filter locations. Examples:
• Country
• State Code
• County
• Location Number
• Occupancy Type
• UserText1 (useful for tagging 
locations with custom labels in 
the LOC file, e.g., “textile mills”)
